description.short_caption: Ulcerated lesion with central eschar on the skin.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a single ulcerated lesion on the skin with a central black eschar surrounded by erythema. The lesion is well-demarcated, with mild perifocal redness and no visible discharge. The surrounding skin appears intact, with a few smaller erythematous papules nearby. The image is de-identified and focuses on the lesion itself.
visible_findings: ulcerated lesion with central black eschar

description.short_caption: Two erythematous papules on the forearm, suggestive of insect bites.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the forearm with two distinct, erythematous papules. The lesions are round, slightly raised, and appear to have a central punctum, consistent with insect bites. The surrounding skin appears normal without significant erythema or swelling. The image is well-lit, and the lesions are clearly visible against the lighter skin tone of the forearm.
